usedFor: Solve CRM holds your contacts and Microsoft Excel keeps the table, so “New Contacts” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contacts” in Solve CRM, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each contact you add becomes a row in an Excel table, handy for reporting outside the CRM.

watchOut: “Update Contact” in Solve CRM fires on edits, so the same contact can add another row.
